Esa es la razón de que el acarreo sea el: That is why the carry is a processor's bottleneck. It is the same trade that appears in any optimisation: more space in exchange for less time.

Que el acarreo era el problema se sabía: That the carry was the problem was known before circuits existed. Charles Babbage, designing his analytical engine in the nineteenth century, realised that carrying a digit from wheel to wheel was what slowed the machine most, and designed a mechanism he called the anticipating carriage, to settle all the carries in one pass instead of one after another. It is exactly the same idea that today is called carry lookahead and that processors carry, thought out with gears and a century before there was a transistor.
